Subject: Discovery call — Redwood Inference & Novabit

Hi Liam —

Thanks again for booking time with us. Confirming our 30-minute discovery on Tue, May 4 at 10:00 AM PT / 1:00 PM ET. Quick agenda so we make the most of the slot: 

- 5m intros and desired outcomes
- 10m Novabit's current infra + use case notes
- 10m walkthrough: Redwood serving model and deployment options (hosted vs dedicated vs private)
- 5m next steps / decision criteria

If anything changes, feel free to reschedule via my link: https://calendly.com/redwood/sdr-15

Looking forward —

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
